title: Consistency Is Not Correction: Separating Confidence, Abstention, and Recovery in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.21651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A controller that resamples an answer, escalates to a larger model, or abstains is usually justified by a confidence signal. Three claims about such a signal do not follow from one another: it ranks answers (discrimination), it supports withholding some of them (selective prediction), and it changes an answer for the better (correction utility). We give an exact decomposition of the third into gated recoveries minus gated harms, which bounds whether a comparison can succeed before it is run: a gate that only replaces a proposal can act only where the base policy was already wrong, so the initial error count caps the discordant pairs any correct gate can produce. When that cap falls below the count a paired test needs, the experiment cannot return a positive result for a working mechanism, nor distinguish one from a gate that never fired. translated_title: 一致性并非纠错：分离大语言模型智能体中的置信度、弃权与恢复
translated_abstract: 重新采样答案、升级至更大模型或选择弃权的控制器，其合理性通常由置信度信号来论证。关于这种信号的三个主张并不能相互推导：它能对答案进行排序（判别能力），它能支持对部分答案不予采用（选择性预测），以及它能将答案变得更好（纠错效用）。我们对第三个主张给出了精确分解，即“门控恢复减去门控损害”，这一分解在实验运行之前就限定了比较能否成功：一个只能替换提案的门控只能作用于基础策略已经出错的地方，因此初始错误数量限制了任何正确门控所能产生的不一致对数的上限。当该上限低于配对检验所需的数量时，实验既无法为有效机制返回阳性结果，也无法将其与从未触发的门控区分开来。我们在两个模型规模上测量了这三个目标，发现该界限确实起到约束作用。在小模型套件中
tldr: 该论文将LLM智能体置信度信号的“纠错效用”精确分解为“门控恢复减去门控损害”，并证明当初始错误数低于配对检验所需数量时，实验在数学上不可能验证纠错机制的有效性，也无法将其与从未触发的门控区分开来。
en_tdlr: The paper provides an exact decomposition of a confidence signal's correction utility into gated recoveries minus gated harms, proving that when the initial error count falls below what a paired test requires, no experiment can return a positive result for a working correction mechanism or distinguish it from a gate that never fires.
